item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'set -e
bun build src/cli.ts --target=bun --outfile=/tmp/taskboard-final-check.js >/dev/null
case_dir=$(mktemp -d)
board="$case_dir/nested/board.json"
mkdir -p "$case_dir/nested"
run() { TASKBOARD_FILE="$board" bun run src/cli.ts "$@"; }
a=$(run add --title '"'  Alpha  ' --tags ' A, a ,B,,b ' --due 2024-02-29)
b="'$(run add --title Beta)
l=$(run list --tag A)
d=$(run done 1)
d2=$(run done 1)
run delete 2 >/dev/null
c=$(run add --title Gamma)
s=$(run stats)
A="$a" B="$b" L="$l" D="$d" D2="$d2" C="$c" S="$s" bun -e '"'const vals=[process.env.A,process.env.B,process.env.L,process.env.D,process.env.D2,process.env.C,process.env.S].map(JSON.parse); if(vals[0].id"'!==1||vals[0].title!=="Alpha"||JSON.stringify(vals[0].tags)!==JSON.stringify(["a","b"])) throw Error("add normalization"); if(vals[1].id!==2) throw Error("id 2"); if(vals[2].length!==1||vals[2][0].id!==1) throw Error("tag filter"); if(vals[3].completedAt!==vals[4].completedAt) throw Error("done not idempotent"); if(vals[5].id!==3) throw Error("id reused"); if(vals[6].total!==2||vals[6].done!==1||vals[6].open!==1) throw Error("stats");'"'
for args in \"\" \"add\" \"add --title x --bogus y\" \"list --status nope\" \"list --overdue 2024-02-30\" \"done 1 extra\" \"delete nope\" \"wat\"; do
  set +e
  TASKBOARD_FILE=\""'$board" bun run src/cli.ts ${(z)args} >"$case_dir/out" 2>"$case_dir/err"
  rc=$?
  set -e
  test "$rc" -ne 0
  bun -e '"'JSON.parse(await Bun.file(process.argv[1]).text())' \""'$case_dir/out"
  test -s "$case_dir/err"
done
before=$(shasum "$board" | cut -d'"' ' -f1)
set +e
TASKBOARD_FILE=\""'$board" bun run src/cli.ts delete 999 >/dev/null 2>/dev/null
set -e
after=$(shasum "$board" | cut -d'"' ' -f1)
test \""'$before" = "$after"
find "$case_dir/nested" -maxdepth 1 -type f -print
printf '"'final-regression: ok\\n'"
